clock_identity.description: PTP clock identity as 16-hex-digit string (e.g., '001B44FFFE5A3B12'). Set to 'auto' to derive from MAC address of interface.

interface.description: Network interface to use for PTP peer-to-peer communication (must support hardware timestamping).

priority1.description: Priority1 field for best master clock selection (0–255). Lower = higher priority. Recommended: 248 for ordinary clock, 130–140 for boundary/transparent clock.

clock_class.description: Clock class (0–255), indicating quality. Lower = better (0=primary reference, 6–7=ordinary clock, 13–14=transparent clock).

frequency_offset.description: Manual frequency offset in parts per billion (ppb). Range: ±1,000,000. Use to calibrate oscillator.

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging (0–7). 7 = debug; 3 = info; 0 = quiet.

p2p_delay_req_interval.description: P2P delay request interval as exponent of 2 (s). Value = 2^(-n). n=0 → 1s, n=-1 → 2s. Recommended: 0 (1s).

ssm_enabled.description: Enable SSM-based P2P discovery instead of multicast. Required only for specific network topologies (e.g., firewalled or unicast-only P2P).

ssm_address.description: SSM multicast group address (e.g., '232.0.0.1') — required if ssm_enabled=true.

ssm_interface.description: Network interface to bind SSM traffic (defaults to `interface` if omitted).

hw_timestamping.description: Enable hardware timestamping for precise timing. Required for sub-100ns accuracy.

max_frequency.description: Maximum allowed frequency error in ppb×10⁶ (i.e., 10 ppm = 10000000). Used for sanity checks in calibration.

phc2sys_config_path.description: Path to phc2sys config file if system clock sync is needed (e.g., '/etc/linuxptp/phc2sys.conf').
